The Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Ananda Chandra
 Behera
This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

2. This is an appeal under Section 14-A(2) of SC & ST (PA) Act, 1989, which has been preferred by the appellant against an order of rejection of his bail passed on dated 23.08.2024 by the learned Addl. Sessions Judge, Bonai in Spl. G.R. No.03 of 2024 in connection with Tikayatpali P.S. Case No.33 of 2024.
3. I have already heard from the learned counsel for the appellant and learned Addl. Standing Counsel for the State.

4. The appellant is in jail custody having been implicated under Section 376-D, 506 & 34 of the IPC,
1860 read with Section 3(1)(r)(s)(w)(i) of SC & ST (PoA) Act, 1989 on the allegations of commission of gang rape being associated with his co-accused persons.

5. So, taking the nature of allegations alleged against him (appellant) into account, I feel it proper not to allow the appellant to go on bail, as during trial the victim has not been examined as yet.
6. Therefore, the prayer for bail of the appellant is refused.
7. Accordingly, the CRLA of the appellant is dismissed giving liberty to the appellant to approach for bail again after completion of examination of the victim before the Trial Court.
8. As such, the CRLA filed by the appellant is disposed of finally.

9. Grant certified copy of this order to the appellant on proper application.
